variables.description: Columns to examine. Empty means every column except the group variable.

group.description: Optional column to split the per-variable summary and plot by.

naValues.description: Values that stand for missing in the source data, e.g. "-99" or "" (empty string). Treated as missing for this analysis only.

variableSummary.description: Missing count and percentage per variable, by group when group is set (naniar::miss_var_summary).

caseSummary.description: Number of rows by how many values they miss (naniar::miss_case_table).

patterns.description: Table of missingness patterns (which variables are missing together).

variables.description: Bar chart of missing percentage per variable (naniar::gg_miss_var).

matrix.description: Where values are missing, row by variable (naniar::vis_miss).

cluster.description: Order the rows of the missingness map so similar rows sit together (vis_miss cluster = TRUE).

byGroup.description: Missing percentage per variable for each value of the group variable; needs group.

upset.description: UpSet plot of combinations of missing variables (naniar::gg_miss_upset; needs UpSetR).

upsetSets.description: Variables with the most missing values to include in the UpSet plot.

span.description: Missing percentage of one variable in consecutive blocks of rows, for data in time order (naniar::gg_miss_span).

spanSize.description: Rows per block in the span plot.

method.description: mice method for numeric variables (factors get mice's defaults).

saveAs.description: If set, the mids object is saved in the R session under this name.

convergence.description: Trace plot of the imputed values' mean and SD over iterations, per imputation.

densities.description: Density of observed vs imputed values per numeric variable.

scatter.description: Scatter plot of x and y that also shows rows where either is missing (naniar::geom_miss_point).

x.description: Numeric column on the x axis of the missingness scatter plot.

y.description: Numeric column on the y axis of the missingness scatter plot.

shadowDensity.description: Distribution of `variable` in rows where `by` is missing vs observed (shadow matrix, naniar::bind_shadow), with a summary table.

variable.description: Numeric column whose distribution is compared.

by.description: Column whose missingness splits the rows.

enabled.description: Scatter plot of x and y with imputed values coloured, to see what an imputation does.

method.description: below: shift missing values below the minimum (naniar's display), mean/median: single imputation, mice: the first mice imputation (needs impute.enabled).

x.description: Numeric column on the x axis.

y.description: Numeric column on the y axis.
